model.description: Microsoft SpeechT5 fine-tuned on LibriTTS for browser-local English text-to-speech. It uses a 512-value speaker embedding and returns 16 kHz mono PCM samples.
intendedUses: Local English narration and accessibility prototypes.
Generating short, user-reviewed voice prompts in a browser.
Researching speaker-conditioned text-to-speech with supplied embeddings.
limitations: The source model is trained for English; other languages and code-switching are unsupported.
Names, acronyms, numbers, punctuation, and uncommon words may be pronounced incorrectly.
Speaker embeddings influence voice characteristics but do not guarantee faithful identity reproduction.
Synthetic audio may contain omissions, repetitions, artifacts, or misleading prosody and must not be used for impersonation, deception, or safety-critical communication.

fixture.reference: 64-bin absolute-amplitude envelope generated by FP32/WASM and checked into the fixture

benchmark.qualityGate: Finite, non-clipped, non-silent 16 kHz audio of plausible duration whose normalized 64-bin amplitude envelope has dynamic-time-warping distance at most 0.45 from the checked-in stochastic FP32/WASM reference.
benchmark.environment: Isolated headless Google Chrome on macOS; Transformers.js 3.7.6
invalidatedBy: fixture, speaker embedding, reference, or quality-gate change
